meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: Claude会运用Emil Kowalski的设计工程理念，在审查UI代码时用Before/After表格给出具体改进建议，包括动画缓动、时长、交互反馈等，使界面细节更精致。
howto.when: 当用户提出界面设计、动画优化或组件交互相关问题时触发；若首次调用且无具体问题，会先显示欢迎语并等待提问。

say.text: 帮我按Emil的框架检查这段动画代码。
say.note: 它会用Before/After表格分析并给出调整建议。

say.text: 这个弹窗的出现动画怎么做更自然？
say.note: 它会建议自定义缓动曲线和合适时长。

say.text: 工具提示的悬停延迟怎么优化？
say.note: 它会推荐跳过后续延迟和动画。

howto.what_en: Claude applies Emil Kowalski's design philosophy to review UI code, offering Before/After markdown suggestions on easing, duration, and interaction feedback, resulting in polished details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about UI design, animation optimization, or component interactions. If first invoked without a specific question, it shows a welcome message and waits.

say_en.text: Review this animation code using Emil's framework.
say_en.note: It will analyze and give Before/After suggestions.

say_en.text: How to make this popover appear more natural?
say_en.note: It will suggest custom easing and duration.

say_en.text: How to optimize tooltip hover delay?
say_en.note: It will recommend skipping subsequent delays and animations.
